date_and_identity_questions.question: What authoritative metadata history or original catalogue evidence establishes the actual creation/update day and its stated precision for each blank metd? Dataset publication, survey, process, reference-report dates and rights permission do not answer this question. If unavailable, retain unknown date/hold rather than synthesize a day.

What authoritative source corrects the exact literal2080207 and confirms the intended metadata creation/update date and precision for each source? Do not insert a missing digit or borrow a neighbouring/date-of-attestation value.

For each byte group, which existing provider record IDs/DOIs, source-ID-bearing filenames/notes and current owner/version/file hashes are authoritatively associated? No source XML supplies this provider crosswalk. Unknown associations remain unknown; existing IDs/DOIs/files must survive.

After verified existing crosswalk and ownership evidence, what explicit source-owner decision determines any representative/canonical upload or update identity while preserving both original source IDs and all existing provider records? Hash equality, smallest numeric ID, repeated ProCite0 and titles alone cannot select it.

source_scope_questions.question: For these exact source/hash/field/context bindings, does the stated confidentiality, legal/site restriction or limited disclosure govern the descriptive XML contents as well as the underlying resource? Identify source-specific authority/conditions and whether any sensitive XML content requires a reviewed different artifact; do not treat general rehosting or historic age as disclosure clearance.

For these exact bindings, does contributor/contact/task-leader/Institute/Village/agency permission or collaboration apply to reposting descriptive XML, or solely the underlying resource? If XML, identify applicable existing permission and conditions. The year-2003 wording is preserved; no automatic expiry or authorization is assumed.

For these exact bindings, identify the applicable source-era vendor/site/data-use/department conditions and their scope over descriptive XML. Provide applicable existing XML permission if required. In particular, FGDC-1710 is a distinct comma/period stratum outside the approved821 and cannot inherit that bounded reply.

For these exact mixed-field bindings, establish the literal Unknown field(s) meaning and whether any separate XML restriction exists. Explicit resource availability resolves the named acquisition direction only; it does not resolve mixed Unknown use/access, create a license or extend the109 all-four-Unknown attestation.

For these exact bindings without a sufficient source-specific acquisition reading, clarify whether the literal contact/request/referral applies to underlying-resource acquisition/use or descriptive XML clearance. Exact literal Contact Contributor, Contact Source (without period), custodian/inquiry/referral, paired site URL and spelling/punctuation strata remain distinct from the821 attestation and earlier literal profiles.
For the exact N/A four-field binding, establish its source meaning and any XML access/use conditions; absence of recorded applicability is not a license or permission.
